component.name: Block Wallet
component.summary: Self-custody Bitcoin and Ethereum wallet for Linux phones

description.p: Block Wallet is a self-custody cryptocurrency wallet for the Librem 5 and other GTK4 Linux systems. It is meant to run in Phosh at phone size and as a small window when docked.

Create or restore a BIP39 seed, receive and send Bitcoin (native SegWit) and Ethereum (including a small ERC-20 set), and keep keys in an encrypted store under XDG directories. You can point Bitcoin and Ethereum at your own servers. A test-network switch uses Bitcoin testnet and Sepolia.
This is v0.1.0. Do not store mainnet funds until the Librem 5 checklist in the project documentation is complete on your device.
First packaged release: BTC and ETH send/receive/lock, Flatpak and Debian sketches. Not for mainnet funds until Librem 5 QA is done.
